sources.heldout_note: All fragment task_ids are within the 27 already-exposed IDs (asserted in code). No heldout content was read or exported.

counting_rule: Sample size is counted by independent task_id (issue proxy; repo+base_commit attached per fragment). Attempt counts are secondary diagnostics. Never report 93 runs as 93 samples.

boundaries.no_splicing: Each fragment's steps come from ONE attempt_key in observed order with original step numbers. Failed actions are never deleted to fabricate a clean success trajectory; recovery fragments keep BOTH the error and the later success.
boundaries.no_fake_recovery: Analyst suggestions are never presented as model-made recoveries. Cat4 pivots are explicitly tagged analyst-inferred.
boundaries.gold_separation: Retrospective gold annotations (gold_files, anchor flags, is_gold_file) live ONLY under weak_label with MUST-NOT-enter-candidate-inputs notes. Candidate-visible fields are under steps[]/final_status.
boundaries.thinking: Source traces contain no model thinking; nothing is copied or reconstructed. No full file contents are exported either (reads keep only path+range metadata; edits/commands keep bounded excerpts).
boundaries.excerpts: Per-field cap 1200 chars (source excerpts were already bounded: old/new excerpts, command/stdout/stderr excerpts).
boundaries.excluded_larger_edits: Successful explicit edits exist in 50 attempts / 17 tasks; only the <=300-char small subset (29 attempts / 10 tasks) is indexed here as successful_small_edit. Larger edits are NOT relabeled small.
boundaries.excluded_command_recovery: CommandError-then-later-ok is common (53 attempts / 22 tasks) but conflates code-fix-then-rerun with input correction, so it is NOT indexed as real_error_recovery; only FileEditError->edit-ok and FileReadError->read-ok pairs are.
boundaries.nonpivot_negatives: M07 (fastapi_5077, Success-printing without asserting ForwardRef) and M08 (rich_3130, ten identical outputs then failed edits) are documented NON-pivots and excluded from the positive pivot count.

successful_small_edit.note: Threshold max(old_chars,new_chars)<=300; reference-scope median total change is 12 lines, so this is the narrow-transaction subset.

hypothesis_overturned_pivot.note: Curated positive pivots only (analyst-inferred); M07/M08 non-pivots excluded.
